name: llm_generate
description: Submit a content-generation request to Claude via the Message Batches API. Group all lessons of one module into a single call. Returns a batch_id immediately; results arrive asynchronously (up to 24h) and are delivered back as a tool result keyed by custom_id.

requests.description: One entry per lesson or artifact.

name: slide_render
description: Render a self-contained branded HTML slide to a 1920x1080 PNG. Use for slides, diagrams, lower thirds and thumbnails.

html.description: Complete HTML document with inline CSS; brand fonts and colours only.

name: stock_search
description: Search Pexels and Pixabay for stock video. Returns candidates with URL, duration, resolution, provider and licence.

name: whisper_caption
description: Transcribe an audio or video file locally with Whisper and write an SRT. Returns the SRT path.

name: ffmpeg_assemble
description: Assemble a video from a timeline: chroma-key the presenter (#00FF00), overlay on slides/B-roll, add music ducked under voice, overlays and burned captions. Returns the output path.

timeline_json.description: {output_path, resolution, aspect_ratio, presenter:{path, chroma_key, layout_by_scene}, scenes:[{start, end, source, type, motion?, overlays?}], music:{path, gain_db}, captions?:{srt_path, burn}}

name: media_probe
description: Run ffprobe on a media file. Returns duration, resolution, fps, codecs and audio stream info.

name: storage_save
description: Save text or JSON content to a path in course storage. Overwrites existing files.

name: storage_list
description: List files under a path (e.g. /incoming/) with size and modified time. Use to confirm human uploads.

name: notify_human
description: Send an approval or upload request to the production team. The run pauses until the human responds or the expected uploads appear.
